Author: Solona
Name: Proteus
Description:
• Lets you use overlays — skin-tight gear, tattoos, scales and the like — as a regular Penumbra mod you can toggle on and off, recolour, bind to Glamourer designs and collections, and more.

• Overlays render two ways. Painted into your skin, except now your overlays are dyeable. Or as a second skin, which lets you use sphere maps, metalness and animated glow that skin materials can't do.

• Reshape any mod's models. Paint on your character to pull clothing clear of your body, push it in, smooth it, stretch it across a hollow, or paint where the wind sways it. Hair works too. Edits save into the mod and can be undone.

• Add on/off switches to any part of any mod.

• Make modded hair fit under hats, and undo it any time.

• Import regular old mods and equip them without using a gear slot.

• Save a mod's look as a preset you can wear, share and swap.

• Imports Penumbra .pmp, Onion .omp and Atramentum Luminis .ttmp2 glow tattoos, with no shader mod needed.

• Cloth overlays can enable skindenting with one click.

Type /proteus to manage your Proteus mods.
Punchline: Overlays, off-slot gear and model editing for Penumbra mods
Changelog:
Matcaps in the Studio, move a whole model at once, keep hidden skin in the size set, and smoother play

Matcaps (new)
- The Studio has a Matcaps tab: tick parts of gear, hair, ears, horns or tails and give them a shiny matcap look.
  Works on refits and on Proteus's hair ports too.
- Proteus's own matcap library (over 100, including 95 from sivka's 23Minks pack) downloads the first time you open it.
- Click a matcap to preview it on your character before you apply it; "Apply changes" updates a matcap you already
  made. The amber highlight on ticked parts steps aside while a preview shows.
- Undo says so when there is nothing left to undo, and keeps a material a hair port still uses.

Studio
- Move, Rotate and Scale have an "All" mode: every ticked part of the open model moves as one piece.
- A Move with "Move skin too" now goes exactly as far as you drag.

Body size
- The size set has a "Keep hidden skin" box (off by default): ticked, each body's skin goes in whole where the
  author deleted theirs, for sizes that show missing skin. Shoes and gloves are always cut. Kept skin may show
  through tight cloth.

Design bindings
- A binding changes only when you edit the design in Glamourer or press Update. Re-applying the active design
  puts its binding back.
- Restoring a bound design no longer turns off a skin mod your body needs (the invisible body).

Fixes and performance
- Fewer hitches: less work on the game thread, settings saved in the background.
- Less disk activity while idle, for slow drives.
- NIRÆ's racial bend works again while it is worn (auto refit, the live brush and refits).
- A second-skin file another program holds is retried; if an accessory still isn't drawn, Proteus redraws once and
  only then names it.
- Hair ports name the right skeleton when they refuse, and say which port a new one replaced.
- A pinned colour-row Glow turns off when the Colors window closes.
- What's new and the README cover matcaps, the All mode, Gear shaders and Gear variants.

Please say if anything looks wrong.

Author: Solona
Name: Camera Tools
Description:
• Presents FFXIV's camera to ReShade as an IGCS camera tool, which is what accumulation depth-of-field add-ons need in order to work. Nothing has ever provided one for FFXIV before.

• Works with iMMERSE Parallax DoF and Otis_Inf's IGCS Depth of Field, and with their panorama and multishot capture.

• Frame the shot however you already do — Group Pose, Cammy, Brio. The camera is only taken over while an add-on is stacking frames, and handed straight back afterwards, so this does not compete with anything else you use.

• Requires ReShade 6.4+ with add-on support, plus a compatible depth-of-field add-on.

Type /camtools to see whether an add-on is connected.
Punchline: Lets ReShade's accumulation depth-of-field add-ons drive the GPose camera.

Author: Solona
Name: Milieu
Description:
Projects an HDRI or panorama image onto a sky dome around you, for screenshots and venues. A large dome for outdoor skies, a small one for room interiors.

Type /milieu to open it.
Punchline: Swap the backdrop for an HDRI panorama
Changelog:
Milieu 2611.49.0.0.
- HDRI and panorama backdrops on a sky or room dome, eight bundled scenes.
- Synced delivery is in testing builds only (experimental, not yet tested in game); stable builds hide it.
